mari: Quick heads-up — draft release notes live: https://docs.google.com/... 

omar: can you paste the short bullets here? ops wants rollback criteria + pin.

mari: sure — key bullets:
- model: redwood-v2.1.3-quant
- pin hosted -> v2.1.3; dedicated keeps v2.1.2
- change window: 2026-03-21 22:00-23:00 UTC
- rollback if 5xx rate > 0.5% over 10m OR p95 latency > 350ms

sara: +1. for internal note: mention canary phase first 10% traffic for 30 mins

ginger: capacity ok for fallback, we keep v2.1.2-compat on standby.

mari: deploybot, reserve slot and post canary instructions pls
deploy-bot: slot reserved by @mari for 2026-03-21T22:00Z. To arm canary run:
```
/deploy schedule --service=redwood-inference --model=redwood-v2.1.3-quant --target=canary --pct=10 --time=2026-03-21T22:00Z
```

alex: copy for internal announce — keep it short: what changed, why, rollback lanes, who to page. i'll draft and ping ops for sign-off.

omar: +emoji :thumbsup: i'll run a quick smoke test checklist against staging and paste results here before 20:00 UTC.

sara: ops checklist reminder: update routing pins in runbook, add alert playbook link, confirm ded instance quotas.

mari: I'll update release notes with rollback table and add the deploybot command near the top. ping me when smoke tests are in.

deploy-bot: reminder scheduled 2026-03-21T21:40Z — canary preflight hooks will run at 2026-03-21T21:50Z

omar: noted, will paste smoke output ~21:55.

mari: thanks all — aiming to post internal announcement at 21:10 UTC, will @here in eng-releases with the snippet.

sara: ok to send after alex's sign-off. if we see increased 5xx during canary, rollback immediate and escalate to oncall.

alex: draft is here: https://docs.google.com/.../draft. I'll add a short FAQ and send for final sign-off ~20:45.

mari: perfect. closing loop — i'll pin the final note and the deploybot command in the announcement thread when ready. :sparkles:
